title: Biased Attention: Do Vision Transformers Amplify Gender Bias More than Convolutional Neural Networks?
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on measuring gender bias amplification in Vision Transformer (ViT) models compared to Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), particularly in the context of occupational stereotypes.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its analysis is exclusively focused on gender bias.
